title: ReadMore-1
body_text: W: Hello, everyone. The movie I’m going to introduce today is The Song of Love. It’s a movie about a pianist who loses his love for music. He moves to a small town for a new start. There, he begins teaching music to children and finds his love for music again. This movie has great music and a touching story, so I strongly recommend it.
